leads.subject: Cican surname global distribution
leads.scope: Romania, Turkey, United States, Indonesia, India, Brazil, Cyprus, England, Peru, Slovenia and reported Çiçan variant
leads.next_action: Locate underlying civil, census, immigration, directory, archival or institutional records rather than treating surname-distribution counts as people.

leads.subject: Nicolae Cican / Culicea Cican migration and Society Speranța
leads.next_action: Recover passenger/immigration, school, naturalization, city-directory and Society archive records; reconcile Nicolae Cican, Nicolae (Culicea) Cican and spelling variants.

leads.subject: 1903 Society Speranța founding group
leads.next_action: Search the Society's archival material and contemporary newspapers for Spiru/Spirea Cican, Nasta Cican and Dina Cican and identify whether later records refer to the same individuals.

leads.subject: Helen Cican and Frank A. Cican
leads.next_action: Find underlying vital, census, obituary and cemetery records to confirm identities and investigate whether the two records are related.

leads.subject: Turkey Cican / Çiçan cluster
leads.scope: Turkey, especially Diyarbakır and Van; variant Çiçan
leads.next_action: Search Turkish institutional, municipal, cemetery, newspaper, academic and historical sources. Keep living-person records privacy-minimized.

leads.subject: Romanian Cican concentration
leads.scope: Argeș, Gorj, Mehedinți and wider Romania
leads.next_action: Expand person-level extraction from historical newspapers, civil/parish records, military lists, school records, official gazettes, directories and local archives.

leads.subject: Grigore Cican academic/research record
leads.scope: Romania; public academic and research records
leads.next_action: Reconcile institutional profiles and publications and retain only public professional information appropriate for a living-person archive.

leads.subject: Simona Cican academic/professional record
leads.scope: Romania; public academic and professional records
leads.next_action: Reconcile institutional and publication records before creating or merging a person identity; do not aggregate private-person information.

leads.subject: Cătălin Daniel Cican sports record
leads.scope: Gorj, Romania; official football registration records
leads.next_action: Use official sporting records to establish the documentary identity and avoid merging with similarly named people.

leads.subject: Adrian Cican public institutional record
leads.scope: Orșova, Mehedinți, Romania; public institutional records
leads.next_action: Reconcile municipal, professional and other public records before merging similarly named Adrian Cican records.

leads.subject: 1547 Iurghiceni property chain
leads.scope: Iurghiceni on the Bahlui, Hârlău district, Moldavia, 1547–1619
leads.next_action: Compare the 1547 Cican–Illea charter with the 1591–1592 Iurghiceni sale, then extend the chain through the explicitly Iurghiceni documents of 1611 and 1619. The 1599 BNaR item at cotă 15a is a separate court judgment and is not currently identified as an Iurghiceni document; inspect it only for potentially relevant names or property references.

leads.subject: Iurghiceni 1591–1599 ownership continuity
leads.scope: Iurghiceni continuity research; BNaR cotă 14 (1591–1592), followed by Iurghiceni documents at cotă 18 (1611) and cotă 24–28 (1619)
leads.next_action: Obtain and transcribe the 1591–1592 original, then compare named people, kinship terms and property fractions with the 1547 Cican–Illea charter and the 1611/1619 Iurghiceni records. The 1599 cotă 15a item is not identified as Iurghiceni in the BNaR inventory, so it must not be treated as a continuity document without further evidence.
